items.en: Slovenia's Valhalla Turrets announces new Skythunder counter-drone air-defence variant with 20 mm M197 three-barrel Gatling and 70 mm guided rockets
items.nl: Sloveense Valhalla Turrets kondigt nieuwe Skythunder-variant tegen drones aan met driebuizig 20mm-M197-Gatlingkanon en geleide 70mm-raketten
items.sEn: Slovenian company Valhalla Turrets has announced on X a new version of its Skythunder air-defence system, intended to engage UAVs and other low-flying targets and to protect critical infrastructure against mass attacks, Militarnyi reports.
